policy: Evidence-only update. Main is unchanged by this research operation. No forecast or market feature is admitted from non-synchronized or universe-inconsistent market proxies.

nodes.label: Coinbase Q3 2026 results scheduled after US market close on Oct 29
Circle Q3 2026 results scheduled for Nov 4, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET
Alpha Finance XRP ETF series: five funds through Oct 28
XRP Insights holdings series: six spot funds plus BITW, Oct 26-27 settled flows

edges.claim: Main still publishes 1,659 checked, 772 correct and 46.5%, while the evaluator scores later live prices at variable elapsed horizons and mutates historical rows. This is not a fixed-horizon out-of-sample metric.
PR #1301 gate run 40855279396 completed successfully. Core CI run 40855279351 was still in progress at the snapshot cutoff; no full-suite pass is claimed yet.
Coinbase scheduled Q3 results for after market close on Oct 29. At the 10:09 UTC cutoff the release was not yet due; no post-release result or XRP effect is inferred.
Circle scheduled Q3 results for Nov 4 at 8:00 a.m. ET. Coinbase and Circle disclosure dates are separate; common stablecoin exposure does not imply identical revenue drivers or direct XRP demand.

Alpha Finance reports zero net flow for its five-fund series on Oct 28, while XRP Insights reports -3,132,685 XRP across six spot funds plus BITW over Oct 26-27 and labels Oct 28 provisional. Different dates, fund populations, units and settlement states prevent a direct contradiction or feature admission.

Reported zero net flow in the latest Alpha session is not evidence of no institutional demand overall, nor does it establish a price effect. Partial reporting, different fund coverage, derivatives positioning, macro factors and timing are plausible alternatives.

hypotheses.statement: XRP ETF marginal spot demand may have cooled at the Oct 28 session relative to cumulative holdings.
disconfirming_evidence: XRP Insights Oct 28 row remains provisional and only 2 of 5 funds had reported at its capture.
ETF flows are not all spot demand; existing holdings, OTC, non-US funds and direct token purchases are outside the proxy.
tests_needed: Reconcile daily issuer-level shares outstanding and XRP holdings by fund.
Normalize USD flows and XRP units to a common date and settlement cutoff.
Compare with synchronized spot volume, exchange net flows, OI, funding and market beta.

hypotheses.statement: ETF flow alone explains XRP price direction.
disconfirming_evidence: Positive or zero ETF flows can coincide with falling or flat prices.
The current flow proxies use different fund universes and settlement cutoffs.
No synchronized causal/event-study dataset has been built.
tests_needed: Pre-registered event windows, market-beta controls, lead/lag analysis and placebo dates.

hypotheses.statement: Coinbase Q3 results could change the market's view of stablecoin-related revenue diversification, but any XRP impact is indirect unless XRP-specific data are disclosed.
disconfirming_evidence: Q3 results were not yet published at cutoff.
USDC circulation and gross transaction volume do not equal XRP flows.
Coinbase revenue and XRP spot demand are distinct variables.
tests_needed: Extract Q3 reported metrics from official release after publication; separate USDC balances, distribution economics, XRP-specific volumes/custody/collateral and broad market conditions.
